//: `prisma/` is excluded, and that is what makes the output land at
dist/main.js rather than dist/src/main.js. TypeScript infers the output
layout from the common directory of everything it compiles, so
prisma/seed.ts sitting outside src/ pushed the root up to the project and
moved every compiled file down a level.
The Docker image starts `node dist/main`, so the containerised API could
never boot: it restart-looped on MODULE_NOT_FOUND while every test and
every typecheck passed, because none of them run the built output.
Nothing needs the seed compiled: prisma.config.ts runs it through ts-node.
